result.note: Tests the diplomatic channel and funeral itinerary for Khamenei and India's 2024 precedent on Raisi's death. India's response is pending, so it is not tested.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Iran invited Prime Minister Narendra Modi to the state funeral of former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Consider the following statements:
items: The invitation was conveyed to the Ministry of External Affairs through a note verbale.
In March 2026, Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri signed the condolence book at Iran's embassy.
Khamenei's burial is scheduled to take place at Qom.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. The body lies in state in Tehran and the processions pass through Qom, Najaf and Karbala, but the burial is at Mashhad. Misri's signing on 5 March was India's first message of sympathy, and sending a civil servant rather than a minister was a deliberately understated gesture.
questions.source: The body lies in state in Tehran before processions through Qom, Najaf, and Karbala, with the burial at Mashhad.

questions.prompt: When Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi died in 2024, whom did India send to Tehran?
questions.explain: India also declared a day of national mourning for Raisi. That precedent is now the benchmark against which India's representation at Khamenei's funeral will be judged.
questions.source: When Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi died in 2024, India declared a day of national mourning and sent the vice president to Tehran.
